licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets cover the full distribution: fraudulent acts to obtain licenses or fees; criminal convictions; clinical negligence/incompetence; substance abuse/mental-physical impairment; broad unprofessional/immoral/ethical conduct; aiding unlicensed practice or improper delegation; false advertising; fee splitting, kickbacks, and billing fraud; and violations of statutes, board orders, reporting duties, and administrative requirements.
